content.text:
<document id=DOC_posting_odd_headers>
What you will need on day one.
1. Python.
2. SQL.

What would make you stand out.
3. Grafana.
4. Technical writing.
</document>

The posting below groups its requirements under headers. Say for each
header whether the requirements under it are mandatory or optional, and
say what in the header told you.

response.text:
**"What you will need on day one."** covers Python and SQL, and these are **mandatory**.
- "Need" signals a requirement, not a preference.
- "On day one" means you're expected to have these skills when you start, not pick them up on the job.

**"What would make you stand out."** covers Grafana and technical writing, and these are **optional**, nice-to-haves.
- "Would" is conditional, not a firm expectation.
- "Stand out" implies these set you apart from other candidates who already meet the baseline. You can be a viable applicant without them.

The numbering runs 1–4 straight through both sections, so it doesn't distinguish the groups. Only the header wording does.
